_comment: Manifest entries outside nightly_matrix.json, run by .github/workflows/regression-extended.yml: weekly always, daily only when the account's Actions queue is idle. Must be manifest names, disjoint from the nightly list.

_excluded.mimo-asr: needs the --codec-model mimo-tokenizer companion, which run_one.py does not pass (exit 13)
_excluded.mimo-audio-tokenizer: outputs RVQ codes, not a transcript; run_one.py has no codes-hash check
_excluded.lid-cld3-f16: text LID fed via LID_TEXT; run_one.py does not set it (exit 3)
_excluded.titanet-large: outputs a speaker embedding; run_one.py has no embedding check (exit 3)
